hints.title: Shortest Transformation Paths
hints.text: Explore word mutations layer by layer to identify the minimum distance to the target word before reconstructing paths.

hints.title: Layer-by-Layer Word Erasure
hints.text: Remove visited words from the available word set only after an entire breadth level is finished to allow alternate shortest routes.

hints.title: Breadth-First Parents Graph and Depth-First Backtracking
hints.text: Run breadth search to determine shortest distance and record predecessor DAG links for words reached at each step. Once the target level is reached, backtrack from endWord back to beginWord using stored predecessor links, then reverse paths.

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Storing full path lists in BFS queue consumes exponential memory.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Predecessor adjacency mapping avoids path duplication during search.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Remove visited nodes only after completing an entire level to capture all equidistant shortest paths.
